nom: Thayers Milky Hydrating Face Toner with Snow Mushroom and Hyaluronic Acid

segments.oily: Some oily-skin reviewers report the toner adds moisture without greasiness and even helps smooth pores, though one oily-skin reviewer found the texture too thick to work into skin.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers most consistently praise this toner for hydration, softness and no stinging or stripping, describing it as a staple for flaking or dehydrated skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report mixed results, from clearer breakouts and good makeup wear to a bad breakout on the chin and jaw area.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers largely report no irritation, redness or stinging, calling it one of the few products that never bothers reactive skin, though a couple say their sensitive skin still reacted with breakouts.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers describe strong hydration, reduced dryness-related redness, and one long-term user reports reduced bruising and sun-damage redness on the face and arms.
segments.normal: One reviewer with fair, easily reddened skin (self-described normal/dry, reactive) reports even tone and no irritation.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 50 or self-described as mature report visible hydration and comfort improvements, with one long-term user reporting less redness from sun damage and reduced bruising on skin over time.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report significant, lasting hydration and softness after use, describing it as a staple before moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness, including one with sun-damage-related redness and another with reactive, easily flushed skin; no dissent noted on this concern.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema or stripped, reactive skin report the toner does not sting or burn and feels soothing, though a few with sensitive skin still report breakouts or tightness.
concerns.spots: Not enough reviews specifically address hyperpigmentation or dark spots beyond one mention of a hyperpigmentation-prone user finding it non-stripping and gentle.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report new breakouts, some describing cystic acne, appearing within days of starting use, particularly on the chin and jawline; against this, several other reviewers state it does not break them out and even improved bumps or clogged pores.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report it controls shine and reduces oil production without feeling greasy, with one exception finding it too thick and sticky to feel controlling.

extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this product so bad because of all the good reviews that it has. But it just didn't work for me. I have combination skin that leans towards the dryer side around my chin and mouth area. I am also very acne prone. With that said, with any product, I always make sure to look up the ingredients to make sure it isn't going to clog my pores. And I was excited to see that this product didn't have any bad ingredients! So I decided to purchase it. The consistency is super thick so it is a little harder to run into the skin. But this was not hydrating to me at all. Immediately after putting it on my skin felt tight and sticky. And I started to breakout pretty bad on my chin after just a few days of using this toner. I've since stopped using this toner and hoping my skin goes back to normal!

extraits.titre: Best toner I've ever used ( for dry, red, sensitive skin )
extraits.texte: I have super dry skin with a lot of hyperpigmentation. This toner isnt stripping, its super gentle, has a good consistency. I will buy in bulk. This has helped my skin so much i do love this. Its not for everyone but its a great product with a good price from my stand point

extraits.titre: Amazing product. I hope you never stop making this
extraits.texte: I use this on my face and my forearms. I'm 60 and prone to blood bruising from years of sun damage and it's hereditary, my grandmother's skin went thing and bruised and tore in her late 50's. I bought this for my face. It lessened the red due to sun damage with in a few days AND BEST OF ALL, I put it on my forearms now and I can bang my arm hard and I never blood bruise now, it's incredible. I see you're sold-out. I need to goger more. My arms were so bad I was seriously thinking about getting arm pads to wear just to protect Mt skin but I no longer even need to consider those today. I will say once I stopped putting it on my forearms I was bruising once again, so this is now part of my daily beauty regime. If your embarrassing blood bruises on your arms a worry, please try this Thayers toner with show mushroom. I use cucumber in my face, this toner does not help the blood bruises. The snow mushroom is the bomb. My gf used on her face and her red checks lessened as well. I love both the cucumber toner and the snow mushroom.

I have veryyyyy sensitive dry skin and this toner is divine. I have been using for about 3 weeks and I can tell such a difference. My skin is brighter and glassier, overall very hydrated. And there are no pore clogging ingredients! It's thick and creamy which I love. Will be perfect for summer when I prefer not to use moisturizer.

I have been using this milky toner for about a month and a half now. I have very sensitive skin that gets irritated and red easily. I found this toner to be just perfect- didn't make my skin oily feeling, didn't make it feel tight, didn't sting, and moisturizing, as it claims. Up until now, most toners left my skin feeling very tight and stung when I applied it. Highly recommended

extraits.titre: this is one of the best skincare products I have ever used
extraits.texte: I am over 50 and I have been serious about skin care for a little over 40 years now and this is one of my favorite products ever. my skin is extremely sensitive, combination skin and it leaves every inch of my skin feeling fresh, hydrated, and incredibly comfortable. I look forward to using this product every morning and night. I love that it doesn't have any type of scent good or bad. I love that it doesn't irritate my skin in any situation. My skin can get extremely sensitized and reactive and I always know I can put this on and it will feel better. I randomly bought this product because I quite like the witch hazel, but I've never used anything like this. I wish this had been around my whole life, it sure would've made my teenage skin a different beast. i've recommended this to a few of my friends and they all love it.
Seemed like it worked well for hydration but i had to stop using it three days in because it broke out me pretty bad big cystic acne that i don't normally get anymore.
